title: Feature switches QA: desktop retest
eyebrow: QA · feature switches (#535) and phase 3 (#495) · plugin 2.81.1 on AjsAgent/phase-3-handoff

short.lead: Your first QA run found that sessions in the Claude desktop app saved nothing, and nothing on screen said so. Plugin 2.81.1 makes the three fixes you named: the save also runs after the PowerShell tool, every save and pickup decision prints one grey line starting house-rules, and the version check compares a branch build with its own branch instead of main. A comma now also ends a feature name in your loop lines. verify.py passes 1253 of 1253 checks and tools/verify_tools.py passes 54 of 54. The real cause in the desktop app is still unknown; your retest shows where the save stops.
short.hint: Tap a row to see what was run and what it showed.
items: A save runs after the PowerShell tool

The save's matcher in hooks/hooks.json now names PowerShell, the shell tool on Windows. Live through the shipped run.sh here: a PowerShell call that made ps.txt printed "house-rules autosave: saved 1 changed file(s) on AjsAgent/live (ps.txt) and pushed the save to GitHub." and the test's stand-in for GitHub held refs/house-rules/saves/AjsAgent/live/bc682dda.
Every save and pickup says what it did

Live through run.sh: the end of a turn printed "saved 2 changed file(s) ... and pushed the save to GitHub", then "nothing on AjsAgent/live changed since the last save". The pickup printed "gave Claude the handoff for AjsAgent/live". verify.py also proves the not-a-git-folder line, the nothing-to-pick-up line, and silence with HOUSE_RULES_TRACE=off.
A branch build is checked against its own branch

versioncheck reads the branch from known_marketplaces.json. Against real GitHub, both download routes returned 2.81.0 for AjsAgent/phase-3-handoff (before the bump). tools/use_branch.py, run here in a throwaway settings folder, installed 2.81.1 at commit 90f68b1.
A comma ends a feature name
"Feature switches, the desktop app does not save" now reads as the feature Feature switches (verify.py, design_loop part).
Four steps in the desktop app

Follow the four step cards under "Retest after QA failed" at the end of docs/plans/2026-11-17-phase-3-qa-steps.md: install 2.81.1, quit the app from the tray and reopen it, run one session in C:\Users\aj\Desktop\phase-3-qa, and screenshot every line starting house-rules.

unverified: The desktop app: every run here was a headless session or a direct hook call on Linux
Why the desktop app saved nothing before: unknown until your retest shows which line appears
Your Windows PC with 2.81.1: the switch command ran here only
